onboarding.title: Your next support ticket starts here.
onboarding.intro: Organize ticket details, record troubleshooting steps and generate text ready to paste into your service desk platform.
onboarding.stepsTitle: From your first note to ready-to-use text
onboarding.ticketText: Add a summary, description and troubleshooting steps. Use the side panel alongside your platform or open the full page.
onboarding.copyText: Generate an organized description and paste it into your ticket. Empty sections stay out of the text.
onboarding.reopenText: Click the Service Desk icon in your browser’s extensions menu to open the side panel. From there, “Open in tab” takes you to the full page and “Settings” lets you customize your experience.
onboarding.privacy: Works offline. No account, telemetry or cloud sync.
onboarding.startText: Go straight to the editor without creating an account, choosing a password or unlocking the extension.
onboarding.localTitle: Your records stay in this browser
onboarding.localText: Your ticket is automatically saved in this profile. There is no password or lock: anyone using this profile can access the records.

legacyTitle: Recover a record from the previous version
legacyHint: A password-protected record from the previous version has been preserved. The old password is only needed for one-time recovery. Normal use needs no password. Recovery only fills an empty ticket.
legacyError: Recovery failed. Check the old password and try again. The original data has been preserved.
legacyOccupied: The current ticket already contains data. Preserve it before recovering the old record; nothing was replaced.
